chest_curio_items_add.book.bell.1: A clock that applies effects to nearby creatures
chest_curio_items_add.book.bell.2: Applies one stack of instability every five seconds
chest_curio_items_add.book.bell.3: Deals massive damage after reaching 5 layers
chest_curio_items_add.book.bell.4: This item is inspired by 'Yi Lezi'
item.chest_curio_items_add.bell.string.1: Activates every 5 seconds, centered on the player, applies one instability to creatures within a circle 6 squares outward.
item.chest_curio_items_add.bell.string.3: When fully stacked, stacking again will cause an Shockwave and clear all unstable stacks. Each unstable stack deals 4 true damage.
item.chest_curio_items_add.devil_ringing: Reduces the activation time of the clock by 2 seconds,
Increases the maximum number of unstable stacks by 3, and increases true damage by 1 point per stack
Reduces the target's armor after detonation based on the number of stacks
item.chest_curio_items_add.ectopic_blood: The essence blood bestowed by otherworldly gods, once drunk, can strengthen oneself but will also be rejected by the world it belongs to, labeled as heretic......
Increases maximum HP by 10%, armor by 15%, and all damage by 5%
10% resistance to physical damage, 80% resistance to magic, but also an additional 50% void damage
The death evasion effect of the Undying Totem does not work on you.
item.chest_curio_items_add.fission_emble: Increases creature damage taken by 10% within 10 blocks
Damage received exceeds 25% of maximum health
This trinket's base attributes increase by 105% for 20 seconds
Damage received exceeds 50% of maximum HP
Then damage increases by 50% for 10 seconds
item.chest_curio_items_add.is_gone.strin: Each faith will grant level 1 luck and looting
item.chest_curio_items_add.life_tree.str: No matter how people treat our decaying flesh, the melancholy of lost paths, the pain of failure, the tears of emotion, deep sympathy, or the contemptuous smiles and sharp mockery. I firmly believe that people's countless explorations, wanderings, failures, and successes of our spine will surely be evaluated passionately, objectively, and fairly. Yes, I anxiously await their evaluation. Friend, firmly believe in the future, believe in relentless effort, believe in youth that conquers death, believe in the future, and love life.
Continuously drains the blood of nearby hostile creatures
The higher the player's maximum HP, the more blood is absorbed.
The lower the player's current health, the stronger the lifesteal ability
For friendly creatures, it heals rather than drains
item.chest_curio_items_add.old_hatred.st: Monsters that are your enemy take Wither damage every 3 seconds
Creatures attacking you are blinded for 15 seconds, and you gain 2 Strength for 15 seconds
The lower the player's current health, the stronger the lifesteal ability
The creatures you kill have a chance to drop copper/iron/gold
item.chest_curio_items_add.owner: Source of inspiration/provider of this item:
item.chest_curio_items_add.the_remnants_: When used, detects all entities within a 20m radius (glowing); detects 8 seconds at full health, 15 seconds (20 seconds cooldown) if not used
When a detected target is nearby, increases your movement speed, attack speed, and attack damage
Each target killed restores HP equal to 50% of the damage dealt on the last hit
Increases the range of 6 vibration clocks, applies instability to add an extra layer
Increases the maximum number of unstable layers by 2 layers
Increases the target's damage multiplier per stack by 5% based on the number of stacks
